steps.title: Open the Desk page
steps.narration: We start by opening the Desk page, which is the main hub for analyzing trading data and position quality.
steps.point_out: The page loads with no errors. You can see the Desk heading and various analysis sections below.

steps.title: View the Microscope Readiness panel
steps.narration: Scroll to the bottom and expand the Microscope Readiness section. This shows a summary of the tick data that the analysis engine has processed.
steps.point_out: The panel displays a Corpus Totals table showing 1 distinct symbol-day and 2 datasets, plus a Legacy Tick Shards table with two rows of real PG data from the sip feed — proof that tick data is being recorded and tracked.

steps.title: Verify the Referee Registry section
steps.narration: Scroll and expand the Referee Registry section to confirm all the regression analysis sections are still working.
steps.point_out: The Referee Registry expands to show a table of candidates and their configuration. This confirms the existing analysis infrastructure is intact and responsive.

steps.title: Open the Cockpit for live market data
steps.narration: Now let's open the Cockpit, which displays live market prices and trading tape. This verifies the market data pipeline is still working.
steps.point_out: The page loads with the Tapeology header and a Ticker input field, ready for you to enter a symbol.

steps.title: Enter a ticker symbol to watch
steps.narration: Type SIM-BUYER into the Ticker field to select a symbol for analysis.
steps.point_out: The field accepts the ticker symbol and displays it, ready for the next action.

steps.title: Start watching the live price chart
steps.narration: Click the Watch button to begin viewing the live price chart and trading tape for the selected symbol.
steps.point_out: The page displays a live price chart with candles, volume, and tape data streaming in real-time. This confirms the cockpit's price feed and tape engine are both functioning correctly.
